description_en: Queries slow query log records of a database instance with support for filtering and sorting by multiple conditions
description_zh: 本接口用于查询数据库实例的慢日志记录，支持按多种条件过滤和排序
name: DescribeSlowLogRecords

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en:
The filter parameter.

For more information, refer to the supplementary description
fields.help_zh:
过滤参数。

详情请参见补充说明
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the filter parameter
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
MySQL 
QueryTimeSeconds: query duration in seconds.
LockTimeSeconds: lock time in seconds.
RowsSent: rows sent.
RowsExamined: rows examined.
Redis
QueryTime: query duration.
Timestamp: execution end time.
MongoDB
QueryTime: query duration.
Timestamp: execution end time.
KeysExamined: keys examined.
DocExamined: documents examined.
ReturnNum: rows returned.

<notice>RDS PostgreSQL, PolarDB for PostgreSQL, and SQL Server do not support sorting.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL 
QueryTimeSeconds：查询耗时（秒）。
LockTimeSeconds：锁时间（秒）。
RowsSent：配置行。
RowsExamined：检查行。
Redis
QueryTime：耗时。
Timestamp：执行结束时间。
MongoDB
QueryTime：耗时。
Timestamp：执行结束时间。
KeysExamined：已检查密匙。
DocExamined：已检查文件。
ReturnNum：返回行。

<notice>RDS PostgreSQL、PolarDB PostgreSQL和SQLServer不支持排序。</notice>
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort results in ascending order. Default value: true.

true: ascending order.
false: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
是否升序排序，默认为true。

true：是。
false：否
